description: This course covers the fundamentals of visual programming using Microsoft Visual Studio and C#; introduces object-oriented programming principles through Windows Forms and WPF; explores event-driven programming with delegates and events; implements data binding techniques for UI components; develops graphical user interfaces using XAML and MVVM architecture; integrates databases with Windows applications using ADO.NET and SQL Server; applies design patterns such as Singleton and Factory in GUI development; evaluates performance optimization strategies for GUI applications; constructs complex user interfaces with advanced layout panels and data templates; implements real-time data visualization using charts and graphs; designs modular applications with dependency injection and service locators; evaluates security best practices for Windows applications; constructs scalable applications using WCF and WPF; implements cloud integration with Azure services for GUI applications; and analyzes accessibility standards for UI components.

clos.text: Define the core components of a Windows Forms application, including forms, controls, and event handlers.
Describe the structure and functionality of XAML-based user interfaces in WPF applications.
Explain the event-driven programming model and its implementation using delegates and events in C#.
Apply data binding techniques to synchronize UI components with data sources in WPF applications.
Implement a modular Windows application using dependency injection and service locators.

topics: Introduction to Visual Studio and C#
